sentences.text:
Through: Mr  St  Vi  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJEEV NARULA  ORDER % 04.09.2025 1.

The present applications have been filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with FIR No. 15/2021 dated 11th January, 2021,
registered at P.S. Vivek Vihar, Shahdara under Sections 420 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. The Complainant alleges that an amount of INR 2.34 crores is due from the Applicants in lieu of flats that were booked by him.

3. Mr. V.K. Garg, senior counsel for the Applicants, on instructions, states that notwithstanding the discrepancies between the amount claimed by the Complainant and that disclosed in the FIR, the Applicants are willing to seek an amicable resolution.

Mr. Garg submits that an amount of INR 50,00,000/- has already been paid to the Complainant, as noted in the order dated 2nd September,
2025, passed by ASJ-07, Shahdara District, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The Applicants undertake to make a further payment of INR 50,00,000/- to the Complainant within a period of one week from today.
Mr. Garg requests that the parties be referred to mediation to
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 04/09/2025 at 23:09:34 arrive at a mutually acceptable resolution.
The Complainant, who is present in person, is agreeable.

4. Accordingly, the following directions are issued:
a.
As undertaken by the Applicants, an amount of INR 50,00,000/- shall be paid to the Complainant within one week from today.
b. The parties are referred to the Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre, where they shall appear on 15th September, 2025.

entities.text: Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: c. In light of the fact that the Applicants have approached the matter in a positive manner in order to resolve the disputes and differences between the parties, it is directed that, till the next date of hearing, no coercive action be taken against the Applicants.
5. List before the Court for consideration on 17th October, 2025.
SANJEEV NARULA, J SEPTEMBER 4, 2025 nk
